name: strattrack-elasticsearch
description: StratTrack MCP for Elasticsearch (Elastic Cloud Serverless by default): index notes, search, and 1-2-3 drafts.

elasticsearch_url.title: Elasticsearch URL
elasticsearch_url.description: HTTPS endpoint (e.g. Elastic Cloud Serverless). Optional local dev: http://localhost:9200 after ./scripts/quickstart-local-es.sh.

elasticsearch_api_key.title: Elasticsearch API key (optional for local)
elasticsearch_api_key.description: Kibana “Encoded” API key for Elastic Cloud / Serverless. Leave empty only for unsecured local Docker.

strattrack_index.title: Index name
strattrack_index.description: Index for notes and drawers (run elastic_ensure_index or ./scripts/init-strattrack-index.sh once).
